decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel moved from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019, which signals that the firm committed further once early results came in, and a classic cheese format costs little to keep in an existing dairy range, so keeping the option open is justified even though no information is available after 2019.

The spicy cheese was promoted to its own page in 2019 while weaker launches from the same year (A, B, F) were cut, which suggests it passed the firm's first screening, though a flavoured niche variant carries somewhat more risk of later pruning.

The mild creamy soft cheese was a named, branded line extension that rounded off the new range and got its own page in 2019, which indicates continued commitment, and its low marginal cost within the soft cheese line favours keeping it.
